grafias_do_espelho: THE ONLY SUPPLIER OF FUNNEL-WEB VENOM FOR ANTIVENOM IN AUSTRALIA
texto_aprovado: And none of it runs by itself. North of Sydney, on the Central Coast, the Australian Reptile Park milks funnel-web spiders for their venom. It's the only supplier of funnel-web venom for antivenom in Australia.
